title: Spadone 2021 · Scanner PPS connectivity
citation: Spadone et al. (2021). Frontal and parietal background connectivity and their dynamic changes account for individual differences in the multisensory representation of peripersonal space. Scientific Reports, 11, 20533.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.sample: Secondary analysis of 28 of 38 participants in the Ferri et al. cohort. Subset demographics are uncertain.
published_method.pink_noise: 3100 ms pink-noise trains. Looming 55 to 70 dB SPL, flat 62.5 dB SPL.
published_method.tactile: Electrical stimulation of right index in the main task. Parent experiment describes a 100 µs monophasic rectangular suprathreshold DS7A pulse.
published_method.delay_selection: Select individually from the five behavioral delays. Near = fast and stable response in looming. Far = slow and stable. Match the flat control delays within participant.
published_method.allocation: Study reports eight six-minute runs and 48 trials per each main cell. Parent study reports five runs and 30 per cell. Scope of the reported 20 catches and actual runs are unresolved.
published_method.iti: Printed figure uses 4560, 6200 and 7750 ms. Parent methods report 4650 ms for the lowest interval.
published_method.response: Withhold on right-hand main trials. Left-middle-finger press to left-index catch. Ignore sound and keep eyes closed.
published_method.analysis: Compare background connectivity for looming vs flat in relation to the behavioral boundary, using the reused fMRI data.

implementation_gaps: Timed MR-compatible audio and stimulation with scan synchronization and a left-index catch path are required.
Delivered run manifest, exact catch allocation and event intervals remain unresolved, and the original acquisition and connectivity data are needed for analysis replication.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
